headlines.title: Democratic candidates look to reshape the conversation around gun control to win back rural voters
headlines.description: NBC News’ Ryan Nobles travels to rural districts as Democratic candidates look to reshape the narrative around gun control in hopes of winning back rural voters across the country.

headlines.title: James Talarico faces off against Trump in dueling Texas rallies in election’s final days
headlines.description: Voter enthusiasm in Lubbock, a Texas city of fewer than 300,000, underscored the stakes of a close Senate race in what Democrats call their best chance in a generation.

headlines.title: Dolores Huerta, farmworker and civil rights activist, dies at 96
headlines.description: Huerta co-founded the United Farm Workers with César Chávez, improving the lives of the country's mostly Latino farmworkers and changing the course of the labor movement.

headlines.title: No Clear Winner Yet in Israeli Election
headlines.description: Vote counting is underway in Israel following the pivotal elections on Tuesday. It could take days, if not longer, to know if Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will hold onto power. NBC’s Richard Engel reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: They bought cabins to live on a cruise ship. High fuel costs got them kicked off in Cambodia.
headlines.description: Florida-based Villa Vie Residences said it was working to identify “temporary living arrangements” for people aboard The Odyssey, a 642-foot cruise ship.

headlines.title: Fed expected to hold interest rates steady as inflation tops midterm voters’ concerns
headlines.description: Officials believe there is plenty of time left to tackle inflation, allowing them to avoid making a move so close to an election.

headlines.title: The former youth pastor leading one of the NFL’s best offenses
headlines.description: Nate Scheelhaase, the Los Angeles Rams’ offensive coordinator, is a former youth pastor. He credits time in the church for his success in professional football.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Study estimates 75% of NFL players who died over 15-year span had CTE
headlines.description: An estimated 75% of professional football players who died over a 15-year span had signs of chronic traumatic encephalopathy, or CTE, a study published Wednesday found. It’s the highest estimation to date.

headlines.title: Spain train crash leaves at least 64 dead in second major collision this year
headlines.description: BARCELONA, Spain — At least 68 people were killed and 68 injured when two high-speed trains collided in central Spain on Wednesday, sending carriages careering off the tracks, in the second major accident on the same line in less than a year.
